description: This file is a configuration include defining tuning parameters and features for the 'strongarm' architecture variant in an embedded Linux build system (Yocto/OpenEmbedded). It sets compiler arguments, machine overrrides, and enables specific tuning options for the 'strongarm' processor series.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: A utility function to check if a specific feature string is present within a variable, used to conditionally set configuration parameters.
